summary: America Movil filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder meeting resolutions including a cash dividend of MXN0.54/share (in two installments of MXN0.27 on July 15 and November 11, 2026) and a share buyback program of MXN10,000 million for the April 2026-April 2027 period, which together with existing balance totals MXN21,042.6 million. The board also approved cancellation of treasury shares acquired under the buyback program, reducing capital stock. No premium, advisor, or conditions stated. This is a capital returns event via dividend and buyback, not an acquisition or activist campaign. Watch future buyback execution and capital allocation strategy.
